name: Kazami Tsukasa
source:
Specialty: Trial
Hobby: Reading
Likes: Pancake
Dislikes: War

A boy who time slipped from year 2020. Under the chief, he leads his new life in Taisho era as the detective's assistant. He is useful as he knows a lot of present-day knowledge, but is also often gets surprised by literally the generation gap.

"That's so cool but, you're only thinking about money aren't you, Chief?"
